Modeling PM2.5 sub-species concentration

Si Cheng

2021-11-18

  • Overview
  • Prediction and residual plots
  • Variable importance plots

Overview

This summary includes national air pollution models for PM2.5 sub-species, with a focus on variable importance measures. Among the four PM2.5 sub-species for which data is available, I first focused on elemental carbon (EC) to compare the performance of UK-PLS and spatial RF.

Cross-validated \(R^2\):

  • UK-PLS: 0.75
  • Spatial RF: 0.82 for PL, 0.80 for CV

Prediction and residual plots

The figure below shows a comparison of predicted EC concentration from different models.

load("C:/Users/Si Cheng/Dropbox (Personal)/exposurepred/national/national_ec_spatRF.RData")
rslt.spatrf = rslt

load("C:/Users/Si Cheng/Dropbox (Personal)/exposurepred/national/national_ec_pls_rf.RData")
rslt.pls = rslt

cols = 1:ncol(X)
qs = c(.25, .5, .75)

avg.pls = avg.spatrf = avg.rf = avg.rf.tprs = matrix(NA, ncol = length(qs), nrow = ncol(rslt.spatrf$X.test))
k = 1

for (i in cols){
  if (i > ncol(rslt.spatrf$X.test)){
    break
  }
  for (j in 1:length(qs)){
    avg.pls[i,j] = mean(rslt.pls$Y.pls[,k]^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    avg.spatrf[i,j] = mean(rslt.spatrf$Y.spatrf.pl[,k]^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    # avg.rf[i,j] = mean(rslt.pls[[k]]$Y.rf^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    # avg.rf.tprs[i,j] = mean(rslt.pls[[k]]$Y.rf.tprs^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    k = k + 1
  }
}

plotImp = function(impMat, tt){
  my.alpha = .3
  # colnames(impMat) = c("Method PLS", "Method SpatRF-PL", "Method RF", "Method RF-TPRS")
  colnames(impMat) = c("Method PLS", "Method SpatRF-PL")
  # impMat = impMat[,c(1,2)]
  
  split_cov_name <- function(dt, cov) {
    dt <- suppressWarnings(dt %>%
                             rename(cov_full_name = cov) %>%
                             mutate(
                               buffer = substr(cov_full_name, nchar(cov_full_name)-4, nchar(cov_full_name)),
                               buffer = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(as.integer(buffer)), buffer, NA)),
                               cov = ifelse(is.na(buffer), cov_full_name, substr(cov_full_name, 1, nchar(cov_full_name)-5) )
                             )
    ) %>%
      select(contains("cov"), buffer, everything())
    return(dt)
  }
  
  impMat = as.matrix(impMat)
  rownames(impMat) = (rslt.spatrf$spatrf.varnames)
  dtNew <- impMat %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "cov") %>%
    # rename variables if buffers
    split_cov_name(cov = "cov") %>%
      #make long format for faceting
      gather(key = "Method", value = "Importance", contains("Method")) %>%
      mutate(Method = substr(Method, 8, nchar(Method))) 
  #colnames(dtNew)[4] = "Importance"
  
  dtNew  %>%
    #buffered covariates
    drop_na(buffer) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Importance, y = cov)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=buffer),
               shape=1,
               alpha=my.alpha) +
    scale_size(breaks = c(min(dtNew$buffer, na.rm = T),
                          max(dtNew$buffer, na.rm = T)
    )) + #500, 5000, 10000,
    #non-buffered covariates
    geom_point(data = dtNew[is.na(dtNew$buffer),],
               alpha=my.alpha,
               aes(shape="")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=0,
               linetype="solid",
               alpha=my.alpha) +
    facet_wrap(~ Method, scales = "free_x",
                 labeller = "label_both",
                 nrow = 1) +
    labs(y = "Geocovariate",
         shape= "non-buffer", #"proximity,\nelevation",
         #title = paste("PLS Importance:", pollutant)) +
         title = tt) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", text = element_text(size = 16))
}

plotImp(cbind((avg.pls[,2]) - (avg.pls[,1]), 
              (avg.spatrf[,2]) - (avg.spatrf[,1])),
        "Mean difference in prediction, 25% to 50% quantile, EC")
